description: This file implements the BasketViewModelService class, which provides functionality for managing and retrieving basket data within the eShopWeb application, including creating baskets, fetching basket items, and mapping domain models to view models.

classes.name: BasketViewModelService
classes.description: Service class responsible for handling basket view model operations such as creation, retrieval, and mapping of basket data.

methods.name: GetOrCreateBasketForUser
methods.description: Retrieves an existing basket for a user or creates a new one if none exists.

methods.name: CreateBasketForUser
methods.description: Creates a new basket for the specified user and returns its view model representation.

methods.name: GetBasketItems
methods.description: Fetches the detailed basket items including product info and images.

methods.name: Map
methods.description: Maps a Basket domain object to its corresponding BasketViewModel.

methods.name: CountTotalBasketItems
methods.description: Returns the total count of items in a user's basket.
